newsitem.title: UK: MEPC comments boost UK property sector.
newsitem.headline: MEPC comments boost UK property sector.

text.p: Shares in UK property companies rose on Wednesday after upbeat comments from MEPC Plc at the company's annual shareholders meeting, dealers and analysts said.
MEPC was up 6-1/2p at 460 by 1522 GMT, Land Securities Plc was up 11p at 779-1/2 and Great Portland Estates Plc was up 1p at 218.

Analysts said the MEPC statement confirmed the picture of an improving underlying trend in the industry. "Our view is that the sector is going through a sustained recovery," said Michael Prew at Panmure Gordon.
"There seem to be signs of increasing optimism."

Earlier MEPC chairman Michael Blakenham told the company's AGM the outlook for 1997 was encouraging. "In the UK, rental value growth is becoming more evident with increasing demand for space," he said. "This is the case across all sectors of the market."

Blakenham said MEPC had also seen an increase in investor activity since its valuation last August. "These factors combined with the prospect of continuing economic growth mean that at this early stage of the year the outlook for 1997 is encouraging."
